'''2000 Ottawa Grand Slam''' was the Star Wars CCG constructed event of a Grand Slam 2000 weekend, one of 31 Decipher special tournament weekends in 2000. The winner received a complete set of uncut sheets.<ref name="gs00">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Grand Slam 2000], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010716001210/http://bbs.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="gs00cal">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Grand Slam calendar], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010311080940/http://calder.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Grand Slam (constructed)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 20 May 2000<ref name="tr-d779" />
* '''Site:''' Ottawa, Ontario, Canada; Cumberland, Ontario (near Ottawa), Canada<ref name="tr-d769" />
* '''Players:''' 38<ref name="tr-d779" />

== Decklists ==
Players posted these lists on DeckTech as decks they played at the event; the posted list may differ slightly from the one played.

* [[2000 Ottawa Grand Slam Alex Klammrodt Ottawa GS Winner Deck LS]] ([[Alex Klammrodt]], [[Light]]; 1st) — "won it's game in the 2 game final"
* [[2000 Ottawa Grand Slam Yannick Lapointe Why Hothice plains player are Hot]] ([[Yannick Lapointe]], [[Light]]; 2nd) — "i play with it at Ottawa GS and finished second"
